name: The Alliance Needs More Linen Bandages!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs More Linen Bandages!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ever am I amazed by the selflessness exhibited when so many would instead turn to selfishness instead. Adventurer, I am still in need of a number of linen bandages before my assignment here is fulfilled. Will you aid me once more in the collection of those bandages?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ever am I amazed by the selflessness exhibited when so many would instead turn to selfishness instead. Adventurer, I am still in need of a number of linen bandages before my assignment here is fulfilled. Will you aid me once more in the collection of those bandages?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are to be commended, friend. While there are those that would take advantage of the economics of our war footing to line their pockets in a fervor of greed, you have proven time and again that your devotion to the Alliance, and indeed to all of Azeroth, comes first.
Blessings of Elune be with you always!
